article.story: North Texas (7-2) at UTSA (7-2), Nov. 14 at 9 p.m. EST. Opening Line: North Texas by 1.5. Against the spread: North Texas 6-3, UTSA 5-4. How to watch: ESPNU Key stats North Texas Offense Overall: 535.4 yards per game (1st in FBS) Passing: 343.8 yards per game (2nd) Rushing: 191.7 yards per game (29th) Scoring: 44.7 points per game (2nd) North Texas Defense Overall: 399.7 yards per game (108th in FBS) Passing: 227.3 yards per game (92nd) Rushing: 172.3 yards per game (101st) Scoring: 30.9 points per game (116th) UTSA Offense Overall: 411 yards per game (45th in FBS) Passing: 229.7 yards per game (69th) Rushing: 181.3 yards per game (37th) Scoring: 33 points per game (35th) UTSA Defense Overall: 410.6 yards per game (119th in FBS) Passing: 210 yards per game (60th) Rushing: 200.6 yards per game (128th) Scoring: 29.8 points per game (111th) UTSA is 77th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 39.1% of the time. North Texas ranks 13th on offense, converting on 50% of third downs. UTSA ranks 23rd in the FBS with a +5 turnover margin. Both teams are heavily penalized. North Texas ranks 126th in the FBS averaging 73.2 penalty yards per game, and UTSA ranks 135th with an 80.4-yard average. UTSA is 70th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 84.2% of trips. North Texas' red zone offense ranks 10th, scoring on 93.9% of red zone opportunities. UTSA is 83rd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:39, compared to North Texas' 33rd-ranked average of 31:29. Team leaders North Texas Passing: Tayven Jackson, 2,880 yards, 23 TDs, 5 INTs, 70.8 completion percentage Rushing: Jahiem White, 1,193 yards on 163 carries, 16 TDs Receiving: Justin Stevenson, 898 yards on 55 catches, 8 TDs UTSA Passing: Owen McCown, 2,016 yards, 13 TDs, 4 INTs, 68.0 completion percentage Rushing: Will Henderson III, 682 yards on 120 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Mekhi Anderson, 434 yards on 35 catches, 5 TDs Last game North Texas won 52-23 over Rice on Nov. 7. Jackson passed for 303 yards on 18-of-31 attempts (58.1%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball five times for 2 yards and two rushing touchdowns. White carried the ball 21 times for 139 yards and scored three touchdowns, adding four receptions for 31 yards. Stevenson put up 117 yards on five catches. UTSA was beaten by Florida Atlantic 60-29 on Nov. 5. McCown threw for 265 yards on 20-of-35 attempts (57.1%) with three touchdowns and no interceptions. A'Marion Peterson had 77 rushing yards on six carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for four yards. Anderson put up 117 yards on six catches with two touchdowns. Next game North Texas plays at Tulane on Nov. 21. UTSA plays at UAB on Nov. 21.
